youtube_title: Lost in F&O? Forex / Bitcoin Won't Save You 💸 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: F&O didn't work out, so forex or Bitcoin will be easier?

EU regulator data: 74-89% of retail forex/CFD accounts lose money. Bitcoin swings even harder. And in India, forex trading on foreign apps isn't legal; RBI keeps an Alert List. New market, same mistakes: the skill didn't change, only the ground did.

Rule: master ONE market first: a plan, a stop-loss and a 1-year record. Then explore others slowly, legally, and small.
Moral: Changing the market won't change the trader.

Source: ESMA retail CFD data; RBI Alert List (Nov 2025)
Education only, not investment advice.
